is_anopheles.evidence: Anopheles larvae were collected from Limbe, Tiko and Buea... identified as belonging to the Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) complex (An. coluzzii and An. gambiae (s.s.)) (Page 1, Abstract & Page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The kdr alleles (L1014F and L1014S) were genotyped using the hot ligation oligonucleotide assay (HOLA) (Page 1, Abstract & Page 3, Methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on page 5 details exact SS, SR, and RR genotype counts for L1014F kdr mutation by species (An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s.) across Limbe, Tiko, and Buea (total n=134).

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae of An. gambiae (s.l.) were collected from field developmental sites in Limbe, Tiko and Buea in South-West Cameroon between November and December 2015 and reared to adults (Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting original field collection, susceptibility bioassay, and kdr genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Coordinates provided: Limbe (4°1'30.4"N, 9°11'40.5"E), Tiko (4°4'32.6"N, 9°21'28.9"E) and Buea (4°10'2.4"N, 9°18'27.3"E) in Fako division, South-West Region, Cameroon (Page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections occurred between November and December 2015 (Page 2, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Field collections conducted specifically for this study in late 2015.

supplement.evidence: Genotype numbers (SS, SR, RR) per site and species are fully present in Table 3 in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated pyrethroid (deltamethrin, permethrin) and organophosphate (malathion) susceptibility and Vgsc L1014F / L1014S kdr frequencies in An. coluzzii and An. gambiae (s.s.) populations from three sites in South-West Cameroon (Limbe, Tiko, Buea) collected in late 2015. High resistance to pyrethroids and high L1014F frequencies (66-94%) were detected, with complete susceptibility to malathion.
